text:
alice-marketing: Quick creative brief for a compact launch mini-kit for next Wed webinar. Need first drafts in ~48h. Deliverables: 3 social tiles (1:1, 16:9 hero, 9:16 story), a 2x2 cost vs latency matrix slide (PNG + fig), a waterfall-style sample cost card (one-pager), and a tiny inbound routing microdiagram (CTA -> LP -> 3-email nurture -> SDR). Keep everything mobile-first and accessible.

ben-design: Got it. Two visual directions I can mock: 'Matrix-first' (clean 2x2 + numeric callouts) and 'Narrative' (icon flow + annotations). Quick Q: which headline for hero?

alice-marketing: Use hero headline "Serve inference, not surprises". Tile variants: "Predictable inference, lower cost" and "Ship LLM features, not surprises". Logo: full lockup on hero, stacked on tiles. Add tiny footer: "Illustrative metrics; results may vary."

ben-design: Nice. Color tokens I'm testing (AA pass attempt):
--primary-700: #0b3d91
--primary-500: #3461d3
--accent-400: #ffb547
--text-900: #0b0b0b
I'll produce an alt high-contrast pair.

carla-motion: I can deliver motion-friendly keyframes for the story (5s loop) and 3 hero frames. Will keep token-sparkline and cost-number as separate layers for export. Please prefix export layers with exp_.

danny-growth: For the routing microdiagram: suggested UTM pattern ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=econ_minikit_v1. CTA options: "Watch demo & claim credits" or "See predictable inference in action". Subject lines to A/B: A) "How to predict inference costs" B) "Live demo: cut inference surprises".

assets-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST GENERATED — include Figma link, artboard sizes 1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080, exports PNG 1x/2x, MP4 (story), layered .fig, color tokens, font files, and AA contrast notes. Ensure logo lockups and legal footer on any benchmark card.

ben-design: I'll push two starter comps into Figma today (Matrix-first + Narrative). Prioritizing the 2x2 matrix and routing microdiagram. ETA first frames by Tue EOD.

alice-marketing: Perfect  sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to review. Prioritize matrix slide and routing diagram first. Thanks!
